outcome: Intrusions are spotted and contained within days rather than lingering unnoticed for months.
overview: Government estates attract attackers and are slow to change, which is a poor combination: an intruder who gets in tends to stay, and the estate rarely has the telemetry to say for how long. Falcon puts one agent on endpoints and servers, reports behaviour to a cloud analytics tier, and lets a compromised machine be contained remotely. For a public-sector buyer the decisive question is asked before any of that: whether security telemetry may leave the country at all, and if so to which tenant region.

benefits.text: One agent covers prevention, detection and response rather than three products on one machine
benefits.limits: Consolidation reduces agent conflict; it also concentrates dependency on one vendor’s availability and update quality

benefits.text: Recorded endpoint behaviour lets an intrusion be scoped across machines rather than guessed at
benefits.limits: Scoping depth is bounded by the retention purchased; a long-dwell intrusion may predate the window entirely

benefits.text: A compromised machine can be contained remotely without a site visit
benefits.limits: The platform is agent-and-cloud, so telemetry leaves the customer estate; the tenant region is a design decision to be made and recorded rather than a default to be accepted

residency: Telemetry is processed in the vendor’s cloud in a selected tenant region; for a government entity this is the first question rather than a deployment detail

notFor.situation: An entity whose regulation forbids security telemetry leaving the country with no acceptable tenant region
notFor.why: This is a cloud-analytics platform; where telemetry may not leave, it is not a candidate

notFor.situation: An estate already running another behavioural endpoint sensor in blocking mode
notFor.why: Two sensors on one machine contend and attribution of a fault becomes expensive

scope:
Model: Redington solutions engineering with an accredited CrowdStrike implementation partner · Duration: 6–10 weeks to full deployment with containment authority in place
Support model: Vendor subscription support; Redington coordinates the vendor case. Optional managed detection with an agreed response target.
1) Confirm — telemetry residency position agreed with the regulator, tenant region selected
2) Discover — endpoint inventory including unmanaged machines, agent conflicts, containment baseline
3) Roll out — sensor deployed by ring, detection-only first
4) Enable and hand over — prevention enabled per ring, containment authority live, operations handed over
deliverables: A containment action isolates a test machine and is reversed within the authorisation rule
Endpoint scoping across the estate returns results as a query rather than an investigation
The tenant region matches the recorded residency decision
